page.overview:
Who is Adlai Stevenson?

He appeared in a 1952 public information film about the Moon. He said that he had "no objection" to Americans landing on the Moon.

His grave was seen in Lisa the Iconoclast. Groundskeeper Willie shoveled dirt on a vigil candle lit for Adlai.
